title: My First Pre-Writing Strokes
developmental_focus: The actual developmental precursor to letter writing: basic pre-writing strokes (vertical line, horizontal line, circle, cross, diagonal, curve, zigzag, square) that occupational-therapy guidance identifies as emerging in this order between roughly ages 2 and 3.5, before any letterform tracing is meaningful.
safety_notes: Content generated programmatically (code, not AI image generation) for pixel-precise geometric guides -- no AI content-safety review needed for this book.
Strokes ordered by typical developmental emergence (vertical/horizontal line first, more complex shapes like zigzag and square last).
This book, not the ABC/123 tracing books, is the most age-appropriate 'first tracing' material for a 2-3 year old and is recommended as the starting point in the series.
